name: Shishio Madara
source: 10 years ago he was involved in a strange accident at his company. He is prosecuted by law for illegally conducting human experiments, specifically in studying the nature of human souls. He has allegedly pronounced dead 5 years ago but has recently become known about him and his illegal experiments.
